conversation.user: I just want to renovate one cold, damp bedroom, about 300 sq. ft. of wall area, to stop mold. Can I use this inside, and will it eat up my room space?
conversation.assistant:
Yes, you can absolutely use hempcrete on the interior as a retrofit layer to tackle that dampness and stop mold by naturally regulating indoor humidity. At just 2.5 to 3 inches thick, it will only require about 2.5 to 3 cubic meters of material, so it won't eat up much of your room space at all. 

Rest assured, our hemp-lime materials are 100% legal, 0% THC, fire-resistant, and entirely unrelated to recreational marijuana. 

What type of material are your existing exterior walls made of?
